name: Nicola Petkov
headline: Cinematic edits that keep people watching.
intro: Podcasts, YouTube, short-form, online courses and film. 4 years of client work, 500+ projects every year.
about:
I'm a freelance video editor with 4 years of professional experience and a wide range of clients — from growing creators to YouTube channels with millions of subscribers. I handle 500+ projects a year, so high volume and tight deadlines don't scare me.

My strength is cinematic editing and storytelling: finding the moments that matter and shaping them into something people watch until the end. I've also worked on the post-production of festival award-winning films.

featured.label: Biggest project
featured.title: Peak 21
featured.text: A paid online course by Anti.Prophet with 9 modules, from mindset and dating to workouts, nutrition, budgeting and business. I edited the course's long-form lessons and short-form videos, and separately edited podcasts and Shorts for his YouTube channel.
featured.note: The course is no longer publicly available, so only frames from it are shown here.

process.title: Brief
process.text: You share the footage, references and goals. I ask what I need before I cut.
